heading: Empower a mother, and you empower a whole generation.
lede: Obaatanpa Foundation works across the Wassa Amenfi East Municipality with mothers, adolescent girls, the aged and persons with disabilities — providing dignity, support, and the tools to become self-reliant.
meaning: in Akan, the Good Mother. She provides, she protects, and she does not count the cost. It is the standard we hold ourselves to.
quote: The OBAATANPA Project is about care, compassion, and commitment to community development. We believe good health is a foundation for progress.
quoteContext: Speaking at the presentation of 100 crates of eggs to the Wassa Akropong Government Hospital, November 2025.

programmes.title: Health & Dignity
programmes.body: Sanitary materials, medical care and health education for mothers and adolescent girls — so that no girl misses school for want of a pad, and no mother goes without care.
programmes.metaValue: 100 crates of eggs to the Government Hospital

programmes.title: Social Support
programmes.body: Food items and essential supplies for the aged and for persons living with disabilities, delivered in person, with time taken to sit and listen to what is needed next.

programmes.title: Economic Empowerment
programmes.body: Tools and equipment that let a woman earn for herself and support her household. We give tools, not handouts — the difference is whether the help lasts.

programmes.title: Education & Advocacy
programmes.body: Outreach in schools mentoring adolescent girls and boys, and advocacy with the wider community on gender responsiveness, sensitivity, equality and equity.
